text:
Again the full D-Tide guide later. Unlike before. I need to play around more. Later than usual. Cause I have to make the ecog guides too and the new hm story guide. And the light drama. etc. Too much. I like the changes. But Know that the changes are bad and dumb for the game. Its simply too much for the .001%. It kills 90% of the teams in the game. Especially if this is gonna be madness story. 

Every Madness run takes a while too on exploration stages. Some of the madness clears from CN whales are 100 turns total. With 30 symptom cards. The damage and health scaling also doesn't make sense. Its literally more damage than you can have hp for. By several times. An example is when on stream I fought wave madness elite. 12000 DMG with WEAKNESS. turn 8/9. The damage and health also doesn't scale in a way that makes sense like in other "real" non gacha games. Any raid boss in MMO for example. You can somewhat linear scaling.



The wave 3 boss, for example. Does vastly more damage than Gel

text: I cba, with their nonexistent balance team. In any other game you would be able to clear with any team, just taking longer with free to play or non optimezed teams/setups. But, these changes are ridiculous just massively inflating all stat numbers without balancing any units or game mechanics. It's like you asked a toddler how to make a game harder and they just think of the first Idea just make every enemy stat ×100. Absolutely braindead. The only reason madness is clearable is due to cheesy game mechanics as 90% of whale units don't even do anything. Only units like Vortex that has %max hp, but even then that scaling was only added to the kit as an afterthought. When originally she played as a exalt buffer/dps and realm mastery overload. It's really horrendous what they did to the balance of the game when all the fun comps and fan favorite favorite units aren't even playable.
